stageHelp.PROTOTYPE: Share your demo link and explain how to use it. Submit it, then the innovation office chooses the judges and sends it for review. Judges approve it, send it back for changes, or reject it.
stageHelp.PILOT: You can fill this because your demo was approved. Report what the pilot showed and submit it; the judges then review it the same way.

decisionHelp.APPROVE: it works and can move on

field.notes: Anything else the judges should know
field.summary: What was tested in the pilot
field.next_steps: What is needed to go live

PROTOTYPE.link: A full link the judges can open, starting with https://
PROTOTYPE.how_to_use: Step by step: where to click, any login or test data they need. You can use bold, lists and links.

PILOT.summary: Where, for how long, and with whom.
PILOT.results: Numbers if you have them, compared with your target.

gates.sendHelp: After you submit you can't change it unless the judges send it back. The innovation office then chooses the judges.
gates.sent: Submitted. The innovation office will choose the judges.
gates.changesBody: Read the feedback, update the form below and send it again.

approved.PROTOTYPE: Demo approved. You are eligible for the pilot — fill in the pilot form below.
approved.PILOT: Pilot approved. This can now move to production.

gates.rejectedTitle: This was rejected. See the feedback above.
gates.adminTitle: Judges for this review (Super Admin / DMD)
gates.finalCallHelp: Most judges decide. Use this only to decide yourself; it overrides the judges and needs a reason.
gates.reasonNeeded: Choose a decision and write a reason.
gates.yourDecisionHelp: Open the demo link, try it, then decide. No score is needed.
gates.feedbackFieldHelp: Shared with the candidate without your name. Needed when you send it back or reject it.
gates.majorityNote: {{total}} judges review this. It passes when most approve; the admin can make the final call.
gates.earlierFeedbackHelp: What the candidate was asked to change.
gates.entryNotOpen: The demo step is not open yet. It opens when your entry is shortlisted and a demo is asked for.
gates.adminHelp: Every demo and pilot submitted for review. Open one to choose its judges, send it for review or make the final decision.

PROTOTYPE.notes: Anything else the judges should know

PILOT.summary: What was tested in the pilot
PILOT.next_steps: What is needed to go live

gates.submittedBody: The innovation office will choose the judges and send it for review. You'll be notified when it is with the judges and when they decide.
gates.eligibleBody: Your demo was approved. The pilot form is open below.
gates.pilotLocked: The pilot form opens once your demo is approved.
gates.chooseTitle: Choose judges and send for review
gates.chooseHelp: This was submitted by the candidate and is waiting for you. Choose who reviews it, then send it. Judges see it only after you send it.
gates.suggested: Suggested judges (they judged this work before)
gates.needJudge: Add at least one judge first.
